Anya: Quick thread — planning runtime perf initiatives for next quarter. Need alignment on prioritization across kernels, quant, KV cache, and latency SLOs for Dedicated. Proposing top 3: kernel refactor for better FP16/INT8 paths; KV cache TTL + prefix caching; HW-aware quant profiles. Thoughts? I'll add OKR ties after we pick priorities.

Sam: +1. We should include Dedicated burst/reserve plan. Can we get an initial matrix of expected P50/P95 improv vs cost delta to justify prioritization?

Linh: From model side, quant helps memory but can regress quality. We should gate any quant rollout with eval suites on our top prompt buckets (chat, long-context summarization).

Derek: For kernels, quick wins = fused attention for 2k tokens, better matmul tiling. Risk: kernel refactor is 8-10w dev + validation. Need to scope a PoC that doesn't break existing optimized paths.

Priya: SRE note — KV cache TTL increases hit rate but introduces staleness risk for per-user state. We need invalidation hooks and end-to-end metrics (hit rate, stale-hit rate).

Maya: CS reports 3 enterprise customers asking for <50ms P50 for short prompts on Dedicated. Hitting that is huge for upsell.

Sam: Proposed quick prioritization matrix (very rough):
```
Priority | Impact (P50) | Cost delta | Risk | ETA
Kernel refactor | -30% | +10% | High | 8-10w
KV TTL + prefix | -15% | +3% | Medium | 3-4w
Quant profiles | -20% | -12% | Med | 6-8w
```
Use this to debate tradeoffs.

Anya: Launch criteria suggestion: 1) P50 reduction >=30% for 8/10 internal workloads for kernel changes or equivalent for combos; 2) No eval regression >1% on quality metrics; 3) Console rollout + rollback plan in place; 4) Cost delta per-token <20% (prefer lower).

Derek: About quant: do we want automated per-workload quant scoring? I can build a sweep that outputs latency/quality curves per model variant.

Linh: Yes — offline sweep + eval harness. We need to store eval sets and baseline outputs (versioned). Recommend payload: 10k prompts split across families.

Sam: Timeline proposal (high level): Sprint 1 = kernel PoC + quant sweep infra. Sprint 2 = KV cache changes + canary. Sprint 3 = rollout, perf dashboards, docs.

Anya: OKR mapping: reduce hosted token cost by 12% (KR), increase Dedicated net throughput by 2x (KR), and maintain quality regression <1% (KR).

deploy-bot: Reminder: infra freeze window starts at 1764900000 — plan accordingly.

Priya: Action items: Derek -> kernel PoC doc by EOD Fri; Linh -> quant sweep plan + eval sets by Mon; Sam -> perf baseline screenshots and cost model; Maya -> customer impact list + priorities. I'll add KV invalidation patterns to the infra doc.

Sam: ack — will add perf numbers to the shared sheet: https://tiny.redwood/perf-ram

Anya: Great. Let's reconvene Wed sync to lock priorities and commit sprint scope. :thumbsup:
